pli-tv-bi-vb-ss12:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss12:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā antevāsibhikkhuniyo saṃsaṭṭhā viharanti pāpācārā pāpasaddā pāpasilokā bhikkhunīsaṃghassa vihesikā aññamaññissā vajjapaṭicchādikā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss12:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo saṃsaṭṭhā viharissanti . . . vajjapaṭicchādikā 'ti --pa--.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss12:1.5: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo saṃsaṭṭhā viharanti . . . vajjapaṭicchādikā 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss12:1.8: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo saṃsaṭṭhā viharissanti . . . vajjapaṭicchādikā 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss12:1.11.1: bhikkhuniyo pan' eva saṃsaṭṭhā viharanti pāpācārā pāpasaddā pāpasilokā bhikkhunīsaṃghassa vihesikā aññamaññissā vajjapaṭicchādikā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss12:1.12: tā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhunīhi evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss12:1.14: viviccath' ayye, vivekañ ñeva bhaginīnaṃ saṃgho vaṇṇetīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss12:1.15: evañ ca tā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhunīhi vuccamānā tath' eva paggaṇheyyuṃ, tā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhunīhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbā tassa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss12:1.16: yāvatatiyañ ce samanubhāsiyamānā taṃ paṭinissajjeyyuṃ, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss12:1.17: no ce paṭinissajjeyyuṃ, imāpi bhikkhuniyo yāvatatiyakaṃ dhammaṃ āpannā nissāraṇīyaṃ saṃghādisesan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss12:2.1.4: saṃsaṭṭhā nāma ananulomikena kāyikavācasikena saṃsaṭṭhā viharanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss12:2.1.18: aññāhi bhikkhunīhi yā passanti yā suṇanti tāhi vattabbā:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss12:2.1.27: bhaginiyo kho saṃsaṭṭhā etc.; instead of
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss12:2.1.37: itthannāmā ca itthannāmā ca bhikkhuniyo saṃsaṭṭhā viharanti . . .
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss12:2.1.39: itthannāmañ ca itthannāmañ ca bhikkhuniyo samanubhāseyyā . . .
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss12:2.1.45: itthannāmāya ca itthannāmāya ca bhikkhunīnaṃ) . . . saṃghādisesaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss12:2.1.54: ajjhāpajjantīnaṃ ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ dvīhi kammavācāhi thullaccayā paṭippassambhanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss12:2.1.55: dve tisso ekato samanubhāsitabbā. tat' uttari na samanubhāsitabbā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss12:2.1.59: yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya āpajjanti na saha vatthujjhācārā.
